held.reason: Full official HTML/all-seven-print search and QA41564 were collected. BADS two-cost optional reduction is not currently represented by a full native spell-payment/discard-before-opponent-counter mechanism, and the optional native deployment/fight flag makes the subsequent enemy fight optional whereas the printed fight is mandatory. Correct payment order, no-reduction effects, exact delayed destruction and related counter/extra-turn rulings need full implementation and tests. Do not pin a partial definition or count this card. Print-image full review remains unfinished for the seven BADS prints.

regulationVerification.scope: Current premium and restricted headings excluding comments

ruleEvidence.scope: The rule component relevant to Eden: Eternal Omega moves all cards composing an evolution to hand, including its bases. Verified on the actual registered Eden in both seats for destruction/mana/deck departure. The separate named Beethoven/Star choice from this FAQ is outside this card batch, since Beethoven is not registered; no literal reproduction claim is made for that different scenario.

Civilizations may be changed by effects; face-down mana have only the specified face-down characteristics and only their owner may inspect their faces. Native evolution maintains complete constituent cards. The crystal-armour card expressly grants all five civilizations; current mana-color conditions and real/online payment use that continuous result while hidden identity remains private.

validationNotes.rulingScope: All four official print images/full faces and current restrictions verified. Stop: native S-Trigger and actual DDD declaration/resolution/manual payment from both seats, mandatory two distinct available targetable creatures, exact-source until-own-start lock, evolution inheritance, no stale-incarnation lock and suppression/restoration by actual Genmu. Throne: optional single mana turn-down, exact four-card boundary, owner-only five civilizations, live ignored/sealed/departed source, actual Joe Star effect order including real post-Joe seed entry, correct actual/online colored payment, G-Strike, owner-only private face and generic mana-color conditions. Existing Courtney remains consistent between current face-down mana civilizations, payment and mana-armament conditions; no printed old definition changes. Eden: one actual creature from each required zone with the full battle evolution preserved, invalid/locked bases, mandatory owner-controller deck shuffle and actual QQQX prevention, tapped-source attack/block lock including later and ignored enemies, and native whole-evolution Eternal Omega. The separate named Beethoven-vs-Star choice in QA40288 is reviewed only as general evidence of full evolution return, not falsely reported as a literal named-card reproduction.
validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: An abandoned draft in the previous turn selected already registered Meteor cards; prepare rejected them before any manifest/pin/data write, the exploratory helper change was restored, and the current phase uses three actually unsupported names. Initial focused fixture failures used the nonexistent ddd action instead of declareDDD/summonDDD, read pre-restore object references, compared optional printed civilizations fields directly, and expected Eternal Omega bases to go to grave. Corrected those against actual interfaces and official QA40288. Later fixtures omitted Joe Star activation state, looked for a nonexistent useGStrike action instead of gsDeclare/gsTarget, and placed QQQX on the wrong controlling side; corrected them. Added real source-entry timestamp and strict online private-face assertions. Replaced the provisional bare tap-lock selection flag with the existing spell-aware g1116 untap-lock machinery, so actual Genmu properly suppresses/restores the unresolved-duration prohibition. Final focused passes 94/94, filtered related 462/462, online five/five. No full npm test or known long game/worker/random-play group was run in this phase.
